blocks.text: Sequential phases add: O(n log n) for sorting plus O(n) for the pointer scan, so O(n log n + n)=O(n log n). O(n) reports only the scan and omits executed preprocessing; O(n^2) is not the tight bound because the stated sort and scan do not enumerate all pairs. This defect often survives review when the pattern name is mistaken for an end-to-end complexity guarantee. If sortedness is given by the input, O(n) is accurate; otherwise preprocessing must be explicit.

blocks.text: The partition invariant treats positions outside [left,right] as finalized. Premature movement expands those regions without evidence and can strand a false value in the true prefix or a true value in the false suffix. Unequal group sizes and unequal pointer movement are valid. The repair is scan current boundaries first, check crossing, swap complementary violations, then consume repaired positions.

Shared left/right syntax does not make pointer and window movement semantics interchangeable.

blocks.text: read should count consumed input, while write counts values actually placed in the valid prefix. Unconditional movement makes the two counters collapse into the same quantity and leaves stale or rejected data inside the reported result. Different final pointer positions are normal, and linear runtime does not imply correct output. The repair is to advance write only after writing an accepted value.
